discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.9.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/section_18.9/cis_18.9.39.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win22cis_roca_configuration is the This policy setting allows you to configure how Domain Controllers handle Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) keys that are vulnerable to the "Return of Coppersmith´s attack" (ROCA) vulnerability. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled: Audit. Configuring this setting to Enabled: Block also conforms to the benchmark. 1 - Enabled: Audit 2 - Enabled: Block
odvs.name: roca_configuration

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.9.39.1 | PATCH | Ensure Configure validation of ROCA-vulnerable WHfB keys during authentication is set to Enabled: Audit or higher"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_18_9_39_1
    - prelim_win22cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - rule_18.9.39.1
    - patch
    - sam
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-39
    - NIST800-53R5_SI-16
  block:
    - name: "18.9.39.1 | PATCH | Ensure Configure validation of ROCA-vulnerable WHfB keys during authentication is set to Enabled: Audit or higher | Set Variable"
      when: win22cis_roca_configuration == 1 or win22cis_roca_configuration == 2
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\SAM
        name: SamNGCKeyROCAValidation
        data: "{{ win22cis_roca_configuration }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "18.9.39.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Configure validation of ROCA-vulnerable WHfB keys during authentication is set to Enabled: Audit or higher | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when:
        - win22cis_roca_configuration != 1
        - win22cis_roca_configuration != 2
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid setting for win22cis_roca_configuration. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "18.9.39.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Configure validation of ROCA-vulnerable WHfB keys during authentication is set to Enabled: Audit or higher | Log a warning"
      when:
        - win22cis_roca_configuration != 1
        - win22cis_roca_configuration != 2
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.9.39.1'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
